name: Join
description: Join two or more DataFrames on shared columns (SQL-style inner/left/right/outer merge) inside a MultiQuery pipeline.
usage: ``Join`` is written as a LIST of join rules — add one object per "+". Each rule merges two named DataFrames from the pipeline data dictionary. A rule joins ``left`` and ``right`` when both are given; if only ``right`` is given it joins against the previous result; ``using``/``on`` select the join key columns (omit to join on the index). Rules are applied in order, each feeding the next.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Join type, mapped to the pandas merge ``how``: ``inner`` (default), ``left``, ``right`` or ``outer``.

attributes.name: left
attributes.description: Name of the left DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. Optional: when omitted the previous/first DataFrame is used as the left side.

attributes.name: right
attributes.description: Name of the right DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. This is the DataFrame merged into the left side.

attributes.name: join_conditions
attributes.description: Column-to-column filters applied immediately after the merge. A list of conditions; each compares a left column against a right column using an evaluative expression.

attributes.name: on
attributes.description: Alias of ``using`` (back-compat). Accepts a single column or a list of column names; internally normalized to ``using``.

attributes.name: using
attributes.description: Column name(s) to join on — a list of strings present in both DataFrames. Omit to join on the index.

attributes.name: args
attributes.description: Extra keyword arguments forwarded to ``pandas.merge``. The most common is ``validate`` (the cardinality check).

json_schema.title: Join

type.description: Join type, mapped to the pandas merge ``how``: ``inner`` (default), ``left``, ``right`` or ``outer``.

left.description: Name of the left DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. Optional: when omitted the previous/first DataFrame is used as the left side.

right.description: Name of the right DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. This is the DataFrame merged into the left side.

join_conditions.description: Column-to-column conditions applied after the merge.

expression.description: Evaluative comparison operator between the two columns (e.g. ``==``, ``!=``, ``>=``, ``<=``, ``>``, ``<``).

using.description: Join key columns shared by both DataFrames.

validate.description: Cardinality rule checked after the merge — one_to_one, one_to_many, many_to_one or many_to_many. Raises if the relationship is violated.

json_schema.description: A list of join rules. Each item merges two DataFrames; rules are applied in order so the output of one rule feeds the next.
